mapper.sql: b.id, b.room_id, r.room_number, r.room_name, b.block_type, b.start_date, b.end_date, b.reason, b.record_status, b.split_from_id, b.version, b.created_by, b.created_at, b.updated_by, b.updated_at, b.cancelled_by, b.cancelled_at, b.cancellation_note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM room_inventory_blocks b JOIN rooms r ON r.id = b.room_id WHERE b.record_status = 'effective' AND b.start_date < #{endDateExclusive} AND b.end_date > #{startDate} ORDER BY r.room_number, b.start_date, b.id
SELECT FROM room_inventory_blocks b JOIN rooms r ON r.id = b.room_id WHERE b.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE room_inventory_blocks SET room_id = #{roomId}, block_type = #{blockType}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDateExclusive}, reason = #{reason}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND record_status = 'effective' AND version = #{version}

UPDATE room_inventory_blocks SET record_status = 'cancelled', cancelled_by = #{actor}, cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, cancellation_note = #{note}, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND record_status = 'effective' AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_inventory_block_events ( operation_id, block_id, room_id, event_type, before_type, before_start_date, before_end_date, before_reason, before_status, after_type, after_start_date, after_end_date, after_reason, after_status, action_note, actor_username ) VALUES ( #{operationId}, #{blockId}, #{roomId}, #{eventType}, #{beforeType}, #{beforeStartDate}, #{beforeEndDate}, #{beforeReason}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterType}, #{afterStartDate}, #{afterEndDate}, #{afterReason}, #{afterStatus}, #{actionNote}, #{actorUsername} )
